Name: Festival Tweaks
Author: GoodfellowGoodspring
Description:
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/festival-tweaks.110553/][b][size=3]Chucklefish Forums Link[/size][/b]
[/url]
This mod changes the name of some of the festivals and changes their start and 'deadline' (time to reach by) times. Most festivals now start later to give the player more time to work before play, you will also have more time to reach the festival to mimic that it has been going on all day.

Also edited some mail messages to show the new names and times. In the future, i would like to change the dates of the festivals but so far i have failed to do so.


[b]Egg Festival > The Egg Hunt
[/b][i]10:30am - 4pm[/i][b]

[/b]The festival is all about the Egg Hunt not the celebration of Eggs so i changed the name.
[b]

Flower Dance
[/b][i]10am - 3pm[/i]

Made the start time a hour later.

[b]
Luau > Luau Beach Party[/b]
[i]10:30am - 4pm[/i]

Changed name as personally i had no idea what a 'Luau' was. Its now a Hawaiian styled beach party so it makes sense. Made starting time a bit later and extended the deadline reach time as it would be going on all day.


[b]Dance Of The Moonlight Jellies[/b]
[i]Vanilla[/i]

No changes.

[b]Stardew Valley Fair[/b]
[i]10:30am - 4pm[/i]

Changed times slightly.


[b]Spirit's Eve > [/b][b]Spirit's Night[/b]
[i]9:30pm - 11pm[/i]

Slight name change as a festival the night before something where nothing happens doesn't really make sense. So spirits are now celebrated that night instead. Slightly eariler time so that the kiddies can take part.


[b]Festival of Ice> Winter Festival[/b]
[i]12pm - 4pm[/i]

Later start time for setting up in the snowy conditions etc, and a bit of a shake up.


[b]Feast of the Winterstar > Gifting Day[/b]
[i]8:30am - 3pm

[/i]The idea of the Winter Star is now set a side in favor of 'gifting' to your secret Santa precipitant. Winter Star dialog still exists, but the festival now mimics Christmas Day a bit more.

[/b][size=2]Unzip [/size][b][size=2]contents of packed file into your contents/data folder[/size]
